The '''short-range [[Assassin/Legends|assassin's]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]''' was a model of [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]]<ref name="Bib Fortuna" /> equipped with a flash and noise supressor that could be dismantled for easy concealment.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] carried this type of weapon.<ref name="Bib Fortuna" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'' first named this weapon,<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> while a still image of the blaster in ''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]'' has a caption that reads, "Blaster from ''Return of the Jedi''."<ref name="AFF">''[[Star Wars: The Action Figure Archive]]''</ref>
